title: Natural-language DNS command parsing context for assistant planner
observed_behavior: AssistantContextBuilder included service, LLM, ML, and worker summaries but no DNS zones, endpoints, or policies. AssistantOrchestrator system prompt listed tools without DNS intent mapping guidance.
intended_behavior: The assistant planner receives bounded DNS operational context and explicit DNS intent mapping guidance so NL operator prompts can map to existing event-native DNS MCP tools.
